name: VFSS2022 videofluoroscopic swallow frames (TIB)
what: 440 videofluoroscopic swallow frames with instance masks of the bolus and pharynx, the cervical spine in every frame (doi:10.57702/w1ye2nim; Video-TransUNet)
level_truth: none; cervical spine in field, no vertebra labels
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; open per the listing, licence to confirm on the page; a small labelled cervical fluoroscopy set that the swallow requests (DysphagiaBank, Pittsburgh) do not yet deliver
how_to_get: Open https://service.tib.eu/ldmservice/dataset/vfss2022-dataset and read the licence and the file list.
Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE, U being the address the page gives.
